market_definition: The acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesives market comprises permanently tacky adhesives built on acrylic polymers in solvent, water or hot-melt form. It measures sales of PSA polymer and formulated adhesive sold to tape, label and film converters. BY TECHNOLOGY: Solvent-Borne, Water-Borne, Hot Melt, UV-Curable. BY ADHESION LEVEL: Removable, Semi-Permanent, Permanent. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Tapes, Labels, Protective Films, Medical & Hygiene, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Rubber-based and silicone PSAs; finished tapes and labels; acrylic emulsion laminating adhesives. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor.
